title: LoRA Fine-Tuned Models for Control Systems Course Q\&A: A Multidimensional Evaluation of Model Scale and Rank Effects
abstract: arXiv:2609.13918v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in specialized university courses, but control-systems questions require coordinated terminology, notation, derivations, and stepwise explanations. Direct general-purpose responses may be inconsistently structured and hard to verify. Using exercises and reference solutions from a Linear Control Systems course, we built a supervised fine-tuning dataset of 360 system-user-assistant conversations. We applied LoRA to Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. With identical data splits, inference settings, and evaluation protocols, we compared base and fine-tuned models and tested LoRA ranks r=4, 8, and 16. Evaluation used ROUGE, BERTScore, and structured-output features to measure reference-answer similarity and stability of the Solution-Method-Teaching Points format. translated_title: 面向控制系统课程问答的LoRA微调模型：模型规模与秩效应的多维度评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.13918v1 公告类型： 新论文。大型语言模型（LLMs）在大学专业课程中的应用日益广泛，但控制系统类问题需要术语、符号、推导和分步解释的协调一致，直接使用通用模型的回答可能结构不统一且难以验证。我们利用《线性控制系统》课程的习题和参考答案，构建了一个包含360组系统-用户-助手对话的监督微调数据集，并将LoRA应用于Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct两个模型。在相同的数据划分、推理设置和评估协议下，我们比较了基础模型与微调模型，并测试了LoRA秩r=4、8和16三种设置。评估采用ROUGE、BERTScore和结构化输出特征，以衡量与参考答案的相似度以及“解题方法-教学要点”输出格式的稳定性。结果表明，LoRA在两种模型规模下均提升了答案相似度和结构化输出稳定性。在当前测试集上，7B-r16配置取得了最佳表现。
tldr: 该研究基于线性控制系统课程构建了360组对话的监督微调数据集，证明LoRA微调在Qwen2.5-3B和7B两种规模上均能显著提升课程问答的答案相似度与“解题方法-教学要点”格式的结构化输出稳定性，其中7B模型配合秩16效果最佳。
en_tdlr: This study constructs a 360-conversation supervised fine-tuning dataset from a Linear Control Systems course and shows that LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-3B and 7B models improves both answer similarity and structured-output stability for course Q&A, with the 7B model at rank 16 achieving the best performance.
